instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: SlotWillow Waitlist Relay helps match newly available appointment slots to waiting clients and confirm appointments they accept. A Service Provider releases slots, a Scheduling Clerk matches them to waiting requests whose acceptable date ranges include the slots, and Clients accept or decline offers. Billing and clinical records are excluded.
